name: gesture-tracker-app
description: Gesture Tracker — fully local hand/face/body tracking with gesture control, voice, and OS-level actions. WasmMediaPipe inside Electron, served by a local Node server.

extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: The camera feed stays on this Mac — used for on-device hand, face and pose tracking.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: The microphone is used for local voice commands and reminders. Audio never leaves this Mac.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Controls system volume, media playback and other apps locally.
